summary: Iter-28 Screen & Workflow Verification Matrix against the REAL preview backend (https://req-to-web-1.preview.emergentagent.com) after the P3 Final Hardening merge. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_screen_matrix.py — 38/54 PASS (70%). Playwright runs covered admin login, all 13 sidebar routes, Add Property modal (fill + duplicate check + save), portion/customary switch, Market Evidence page and 11 public pages. CRITICAL: the P3 integrated property write path is completely broken in this environment — POST/PUT /api/properties always returns 500 because IntegratedPropertyService wraps every write in a MongoDB multi-document transaction while MONGO_URL points at a STANDALONE mongod ('Transaction numbers are only allowed on a replica set member or mongos'). Consequently `listings`/`property_parcels`/`parties`/`property_addresses` are all EMPTY (0 docs), GET /api/properties returns [] and the Admin Properties table, /buy, /rent and the home Featured strip show nothing while the Dashboard still reports 'Active properties 9' (read from the legacy `properties` collection, 9 docs, now orphaned/invisible). Second blocker: the Add Property modal posts tenure_type='' for the default 'Not specified' option, and PropertyCreate declares Optional[Literal[...]] so BOTH POST /api/properties and POST /api/properties/duplicate-check return 422 for a fully-filled valid House form — so the UI cannot create a property even once transactions are fixed. Also: staff logins (director/sales/leasing/marketing) all fail 401 — the bcrypt hashes in DB do not match the documented Password@123, and seed_users() intentionally never re-seeds existing users; no brute-force lockout exists; CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False while login sets an httpOnly cookie.

critical.issue: Always 500. core/integrated_property_service.py create/update run inside client.start_session()/start_transaction(); the container MongoDB is standalone (replSetGetStatus -> 'not running with --replSet') so pymongo raises OperationFailure code 20 'Transaction numbers are only allowed on a replica set member or mongos'. Property creation/editing is 100% broken in preview. Needs either a replica-set Mongo or a non-transactional fallback path when the deployment is standalone (catch OperationFailure code 20 / check client topology and write sequentially with compensating cleanup).

Returns [] although 9 properties exist in the legacy `properties` collection and /api/reports/summary reports properties_active=9. In integrated mode the repository reads only `listings` + `master_properties`, and `listings` has 0 docs — the P2/P3 backfill was never applied to the listing graph. Admin Properties table, public /buy, /rent and home Featured are therefore empty. Either run the backfill migration for the 9 legacy rows or make reports/summary read the same source as the list endpoint.

422 literal_error for tenure_type='' — the exact payload the admin Add Property modal sends when Tenure type is left at the default 'Not specified'. Reproduced via API (tenure_type='' -> 422, None -> 200) and in the browser (Save and Check duplicates both 422). Fix: coerce ''->None in the Pydantic model (BeforeValidator) or have PropertyModal submit null.

director@trel.com.pg / sales@trel.com.pg / leasing@trel.com.pg / marketing@trel.com.pg all return 401 with the documented Password@123 (verified with bcrypt.checkpw directly against the stored hashes — no match). seed.py seed_users() skips any existing user, so the documented staff credentials can never be restored. managing_director / sales_agent / leasing_agent / marketing_officer workspaces could NOT be verified.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout: 6+ consecutive wrong passwords for the same account all return 401 (expected 429/423 after 5). Playbook requirement not implemented.

CORSMiddleware(allow_origins=['*'], allow_credentials=False) while login sets an httpOnly `access_token` cookie (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None; Partitioned). Cookie auth cannot work cross-origin; playbook requires explicit origins + allow_credentials=True.

Schema collision: the collection already holds 493 docs written by the market/backfill pipeline (property_class/property_subtype/trel_property_id, no `title`) while IntegratedPropertyService writes a totally different document shape (title/property_type_id/lifecycle_status) into the SAME collection. Market Evidence KPI 'MASTER PROPERTIES 493' is therefore not TREL properties. Namespace one of the two writers.

All market endpoints 200 but market_source_sites/market_source_listings are empty, so Evidence rows cannot be clicked and the 'linked Master Property inspector' path could not be exercised (no data, not a code fault).

Verified by network capture: POST /api/properties/duplicate-check 422, POST /api/properties 422 from the browser; 500 when the same payload is sent with tenure_type omitted.
GET /api/properties returns [] so Admin Properties, /buy, /rent and home Featured are all empty even though 9 legacy properties + dashboard counters exist.
Cannot log in as director/sales/leasing/marketing (401) — role-scoped admin behaviour unverified.

CRITICAL: Accept tenure_type='' (coerce to None) in PropertyCreate/Property, or make PropertyModal send null for 'Not specified'. Currently every Save and Check-duplicates from the admin UI is a 422.

CRITICAL: Reconcile the property read path — either backfill the 9 legacy `properties` docs into master_properties/listings/parcels/addresses or make /api/reports/summary read the integrated graph, so the Dashboard KPI and the Properties table/public search agree.

HIGH: Restore or re-document staff credentials (director/sales/leasing/marketing). Consider an idempotent seed that resets demo (non-admin) staff passwords, and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to whatever is actually true.

critical_code_review_comments: core/integrated_property_service.py: create()/update() unconditionally open a transaction. There is no capability check and no fallback, so the whole property module is coupled to a replica-set deployment that neither preview nor the current MONGO_URL provides. Wrap with a `_supports_transactions()` probe cached at startup.

core/property_repository.py: storage_mode reads the env var on EVERY call and silently falls back to legacy for unknown values; a typo in TREL_PROPERTY_STORAGE_MODE would silently switch storage engines mid-flight. Resolve once at import and log the effective mode.
IntegratedPropertyService writes into `master_properties`, which is already owned by the market backfill with an incompatible schema — two writers, one collection, no discriminator field.

routes/properties.py TENURE_TYPES includes None and '' but models.PropertyCreate.tenure_type is Optional[Literal[...]] — the route-level allowance is dead code because Pydantic rejects '' first. The two validation layers disagree; keep one source of truth.

IntegratedPropertyService.update() rebuilds the whole graph from the request body (build_graph) and upserts with $set, so any field the caller omits is silently reset to its default (e.g. bedrooms->0, features->[]). PUT behaves as a full replace while the UI/other endpoints treat PUT as partial (routes/customers.py merges). Confirm intent.

IntegratedPropertyService.list() fetches limit*2 listings then N+1 projects each one (7 extra find_one per listing) — this will not scale past a few hundred listings; use an aggregation $lookup pipeline.

seed.py seed_users() never updates existing users, so documented demo credentials drift permanently out of sync with the DB (already happened for all 4 staff accounts). At minimum log a warning when a demo user exists with a non-seed hash.

rca_of_the_issue: Two independent root causes make the P3 property screen non-functional. (1) Transactions: IntegratedPropertyService.create/update wrap all 8 graph inserts in `async with await self.client.start_session(): async with session.start_transaction()`. The deployment's MONGO_URL is mongodb://localhost:27017 on a standalone mongod, so the first write inside the session raises pymongo OperationFailure code 20 -> unhandled -> FastAPI 500. Repro: POST /api/properties with any valid payload (curl or UI) and see /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log 'Transaction numbers are only allowed on a replica set member or mongos'. Mitigation: probe `hello`/topology at startup; if no replica set, execute the graph writes sequentially with best-effort rollback, keeping the transactional path for replica-set deployments. (2) Validation contract drift: PropertyModalFields renders the Tenure type select with '' as the 'Not specified' option value and Properties.jsx posts state verbatim, but models.PropertyCreate.tenure_type is Optional[Literal['STATE_LEASE','FREEHOLD','CUSTOMARY','OTHER']] which rejects '' with 422 before any route logic runs (routes/properties.TENURE_TYPES deliberately allows '' but never gets the chance). Repro: POST /api/properties/duplicate-check with tenure_type='' -> 422, with None -> 200. Mitigation: coerce empty string to None in the model or emit null from the UI. A third, data-level consequence: because no create has ever succeeded in integrated mode, the listing graph is empty, so GET /api/properties returns [] while /api/reports/summary still counts the 9 legacy `properties` docs — hence the Dashboard/Properties-table contradiction.
